nom: OSEA Dream Night Serum with Bio-Retinol

avis.texte: This serum is fantastic!! I've been using this for over a year now. I'm 62. I've seen a difference in my skin. It's more plump and the fine lines and wrinkles around my mouth and forehead have lessened considerably. Definitely recommend.

avis.titre: In the morning I look younger.!
avis.texte: Love this wonderful product, is it right before bed and give my face a tap. It soaks right in and does't feel heavy. I am happy I found these products. I'm a fan. Left pic after using product for 4 months right pic before using it. Thank you OSEA woman! Sincerely grateful Deb K

I love the Dream Night Serum and I use it most nights before going to sleep. I DO as your description suggests and leave my face a bit damp before putting it on. This does make the serum hydrate properly and I find that if I don't dampen my skin a bit before putting the serum on, it's noticeably less hydrated.
I use this every night. My skin feels soft and my fine lines on my face are less noticeable.
This with the night dream cream are my nighttime routine. Smell amazing! Lavender smell. So soothing and moisturizing. Great products!

I did not notice any anti aging effects in the two months of using this. Honestly, the sea serum works just as good if not better than this. I'm switching to another brand for anti aging and brightening serums.
I have nothing but good things to say about this. My face feels so amazing after application
It feels very drying to my skin even after my moisturizer. Might be returning it

I've been riding this product as part of my night time regimen before bed. This does exactly what it's supposed to do and doesn't take much to cover the face and neck. It'll definitely be a reorder on my list!
Started seeing a difference in my skin in less than a week. Really thankful to find a quality product thats safe and works.

I use this every night as part of my nightly routine. My skin is now perfect. Ive never used products that didnt cause me to break out besides OSEA!!! Its all clean vegan natural and made from our very own oceans!! Phenomenal way to keep us clean and our environment!! Thank you

avis.titre: Sampled for one night and I was sold!
avis.texte: I received a sample with my order and after the very first night, my skin felt nourished and smooth. I ordered immediately, more than a little concerned that I might run out before my order arrived. This serum I only just discovered, I could now not live without! Ive been using nightly for about two weeks and I am thrilled to say that I agree with the 100% whove experienced a noticeable reduction in wrinkles! Nothing Ive ever tried has worked this well! Ive tried a LOT of expensive serums, oils, and lotions. I still love my oils. This serum goes on after washing and before my facial oil. I wake up younger!
I have been using this for a few months now and have noticed a difference in in my skin already.
I just started using this. Three days in and I cant believe how hydrated and plump my skin feels when I wake up in the morning. Im 54 and live in a dry, winter state and wow! Just wow.
I love this serum! It applies very evenly and smoothly! Osea is amazing and Im so happy I found this clean company!

I am Osea fan. Love all the products. Recently noticed this serum has Phenoxyethanol. Even in small concentration I dont feel comfortable using it. And my return window closed a week ago. Stuck with product I cant return or exchange.

This is the second serum I've tried from Osea. And I like this one better than the Hyaluronic Serum. I think it does more to reduce wrinkles. Plus, I really like the light lavender scent. I'm about halfway through my second bottle, and really happy with it!
Your products are the best I've ever used. This is no exception! My skin is soft and smooth. I can see a lessening in my lines. I'd like to thank #sisters-in-law for introducing me to this brand!

This truly takes care of your skin concerns as its meant to do. Smoother skin will be your results! Im very happy with this product. Ive switched all my skin care to OSEA and Im loving all of it. Just knowing its ingredients are made from earth and sea gives you a peace of mind. Thank you OSEA!

avis.titre: One of my favorite OSEA products
avis.texte: This is a nighttime must! Feels amazing gliding on. Instantly hydrates and seals in moisture. I feel like my skin is glowing when I wake up.
I have not noticed a difference yet. I need to give it a bit longer.
Just what I needed! Hydrates without disappearing or looking goopy.
Smells amazing! Makes my skin so soft. Notice results already!

I went to dermatologist, had two facials by different people, used a retinol cream but nothing helped. Overnight, in 8 hours, a huge difference was noted. This is my miracle cream. I met my new neighbor today who was 37. She said in a whisper, but you don't look 67. Thank you Osea!

Very much enjoy using this serum before my night cream. The combo is 10/10. A little goes a long way with the serum. Love the clean lavender scent. Clean ingredients is something I love about this company!
The Night Serum is amazing! I can already see and feel a difference on my skin. I use many of the OSEA products and they are fabulous! Thank you OSEA.
After just one use I noticed a difference in my face. Cant wait to see what happens over time. Definitely recommend
I thought I loved my other Osea face products but this is my new number 1.

avis.titre: My new Go To retinol switch!
avis.texte: Ive only been using the Dream night serum for two weeks and can feel the difference! In the morning, my face feels tight and hydrated. I didnt buy the cream but its my next big purchase. I have fallen in love with this brand!

So excited to try this. l placed the order a few days ago and didnt read the reviews until this morning. Yes, please consider removing the lavender from this product. I am so allergic to the scent of lavender, there are some adverse reactions to lavender especially for pregnant women. Its extremely unfortunate that anyone slips lavender into any product . Today, most people who love lavender have it in an essential oil form, which is easily added to any product.
This stuff is amazing and I will be restocking it as soon as I am out. Truly cannot go wrong with anything OSEA makes!
I love all my Osea products as you can probably tell by all my orders. My favorites are Dream Cream, serum and the body oil.

avis.titre: Research lavender - not good for all women
avis.texte: Overview Loooove OSEA BUT pleeease consider removing lavender so this is safe for all. Key searches: Lavender oil, pregnancy, safety, estrogen, hormone, estrogen dominant breast cancer - studies have found that lavender and tea tree oils have estrogenic (estrogen-like) and anti-androgenic (testosterone-inhibiting) properties, making them potential endocrine disruptors.

avis.titre: Way too expensive for 1 oz of product!
avis.texte: My bad for not checking the size before ordering. Did not notice any difference between this one and the other serum which is a much larger size! Will definitely NOT be ordering thus again.
A good addition to my nightly routine alongside the Dream Night Cream. It also has a soothing lavender smell that is so calming.
I have been using the night duo of dream night serum and dream night cream and in just a couple of weeks my skin is much more soft than before.

My only regret with this product is that I didnt take a before photo! I am 51 years old and have ‚Äúmature‚Äù skin. Products that used to work for me no longer work. Due to mature skin and significant weight loss I have a saggy chin. I have tried about half a dozen products, some incredibly expensive, and nothing worked like this product. Its light, absorbs into the skin quickly, and I definitely saw overnight results. I will be trying additional products due to my excellent experience with this serum.
I saw visible results in a few days. One of the best products Ive ever used!
I love the serum, but dont care for how it dispenses. I find pushing from the top is awkward. I prefer a squeeze top that siphons the serum into the tube and you squeeze to dispense it.
Love the way this makes my skin feel when I wake up in the morning

I really love this retinol, especially with the night cream. I feel like its helping out my acne as well. It does have a strong pine/woodsy smell but it goes away after a few minutes. If you can handle that, I definitely recommend. I got the trail sizes & am going to purchase regular sizes.

I started using the serum at night and Im only 5 days I can tell the difference! My skin is smoother and softer. Less noticeable wrinkles around my mouth. Love it. Will be a regular purchase ! Worth the money
This is my first time using this product and Ive been so pleased by it. I love the way my facial skin feels and looks. I use it each night without fail! Darlene

avis.titre: Fine, pleasant smell, not as good as some other products
avis.texte: I've been using this serum along with the Dream Night Cream for several weeks. My favorite thing about it is the fragrance which has a gentle sort of metallic floral note- I usually don't like floral but I like this. It feels good going on. My skin seems fine, but not the great condition it was in when I used the now not only discontinued but disappeared without a trace from their website Anti-Aging Serum. I found one of the anti-aging serums still in circulation at Blue Mercury and went back to it for two weeks and my skin seems happier - smoother, calmer, glowier. I'm not sure if I'll return to Dream Night once it's empty, I think I'm back on the hunt to replace the anti-aging one. One other issue I have with this serum is the button cap - it makes it difficult to travel with, I tried it with the Hylauronic Serum s and the whole thing got pressed out in my bag - not risking that again.
This is a great product. Goes on smooth and absorbs wonderfully. I am giving it a 4 instead of 5 because I am not sure it is helping my wrinkles as I had hoped but I love all the OSEA products.

Dream Night Serum with Bio-Retinol is my new must have for most nights. I hop, skip, and jump around with my serums, always looking for the one that works best. . But this one will be a permanent fixture. You do not need much and following up 26th the moisturizer has changed my skin for the better. I was seriously thinking about a infrared face mask or massage tool as I tried one in Sedona. But after using the serum and night moisturizer I have no need of anything else.
The Night Cream was too heavy for my skin, so this is a great alternative! Goes on light and ok to layer

I have been using this nearly nightly for 3 weeks, in combination with the Dream Night Cream. It smells wonderful and is such a treat to use. Unfortunately, it causes my sensitive skin to flare so I can't use it anywhere near my eyes. While I won't be purchasing it again due to my skin sensitivity, I will continue to use it sparingly until I finish it.

avis.titre: Three days and my skin looks smoother!
avis.texte: I am really surprised that I can see anything this fast. In fact, I wasnt even looking for that, but I kept catching a glimpse of myself in the mirror and saying ‚Äúwhy does my skin look so good?‚Äù its the only thing I had changed so I am more than pleased! Note: I got this result with only the serum. I have yet to buy there dream cream, but will be.

avis.titre: Nice but not noticing a difference in my fine lines
avis.texte: This serum feels so good and smells amazing. Ive been pairing it with the night time cream for the past few weeks and its been a nice routine before bed. However- Im not noticing any difference in the appearance of my fine lines. Hoping that changes!

avis.titre: The night dream serum work very well for me my skin is so so
avis.texte: The dream night serum work very well with my skin very smooth and clean

One week using this and I love it. Ive been complemented on my face by my husband who now wants to order and use. Im younger no big wrinkles yet but its definitely firmed up my face and gotten rid of some forehead blemish. Smells great. Definitely recommend

I use this every night with the Dream Night Cream. My skin has been looking and feeling so much softer and smoother. I just started my second bottle. Lavender is not typically my favorite scent but it is soft and subtle with this serum (and cream) and I actually really like their scents before bed. Its a very fresh, relaxing, and subtle scent that is very pleasant.
This serum really works! It has a lovely and relaxing scent and seems to be improving the appearance of fine lines.

avis.titre: Nice but can't use it every day
avis.texte: I really love the way this makes my skin feel, but after 3 or 4 days it started to sting in the night and I woke up with red skin. I think I'm going to have to only use it once a week or so, my skin is very sensitive.
It is a great experience because when I used a serum I get acne and with this one I do not and it is a great complement to my collagen cream
Very disappointed after purchasing over a dozen of your products and seeing no results or differences
My second purchased, must say its a must moving forward. You will not be disappointed.

avis.titre: Started using it a week ago
avis.texte: So far so good. Smells wonderful and along with the OSEA Night Cream my skin is hydrated all through the night. BTW, If you guys would make a sunscreen that jives with your products Id certainly buy it!!

avis.titre: Feels Divine and Smells so Good.
avis.texte: I have been using OSEA products for over 4 years now, and I am so happy they added this Night Serum to the offerings. It makes my skin supple and helps to soften the lines around my eyes. As a maturing woman, I appreciate products that are gentle and effective, vegan and cruelty free.

This serum is a wonderful addition to my night routine. I just started using it so I will see how the results are hopefully in a week or two. After cleansing my face, I apply the dream night serum, then I apply the collagen dream night cream. They both seem to hydrate my skin and help it feel soft. I have sensitive skin and so far it hasnt caused any issues.

Good for sensitive skin. Its easy to apply after a fresh clean face. I also put a dime size in my moisturizer from time to time. I love how it tightens my forehead lines and does make me red. Totally recommend for sensitive skinned people.
It's called a dream for a reason! Feels heavenly. I've noticed a difference on my skin and neck since I began using a few weeks ago. This has prompted me to purchase the eye serum as well.
This is a great serum for my evening face routine. Goes on smoothly & works nicely!

avis.titre: I didn't see a difference after a month
avis.texte: I love the Hyaluronic serum but this one didn't make a difference. It's hard to tell when using in combination with another product like a moisturizer. I used alone and still nothing. I will stick with the other serum and the overnight resurfacing serum which is magic!
My dry aging skin loves this product and esp when used with the Dream Night Cream. I wake up with soft supple skin. Dream combo!
Seems to work well. Need to give it a little more time and but smoothed the line on my forehead.
We love pretty much all OSEA products, so when this new one came out, we were excited to try it. Your face feels amazing when you wake up. Highly recommend.

Great product. In fact I love all the Osea products for body and face.
Love the light lavender scent. This product glides on and dries quickly. Does not leave a filmy feeling after applying. Perfect pairing with the night cream

No joke Ive only tried it a couple times so far (just got it) and when I put it on the first time and smoothed it over my laugh lines, they smoothed away. So, I so enjoy putting this on my face at night. have not noticed any results, used now for 3 weeks each night. Must say the night cream suggested to put on afterwards has not scent and honestly I will not re-order it. Spoils the lovely lavendar from the serum and Again NO positive results.

Love how this one doesnt burn my eyes like the original sea serum does . My skin loves this stuff

having this new product has enhanced my night ritual. The texture and application method invite me to massage my face. I am feeling a smoother facial skin in the morning.

I can't say enough good things! I was never into skincare or makeup. I struggled a bit wit PPD. Coming out of it I've started really taking care of me! This stuff absorbs super quick. Feels like a dream. Not goopy or sitting on the surface. I have oily/combination skin. Or I did pre pregnancy. Postpartum I feel like everything has changed. But regardless of how my skin feels ( dry, oily etc) this stuff fits the bill on every occasion. I don't look as tired! With BABY! I'm starting to look more like myself. This has definitely helped bring my face back to life
Love the delicate smell of this serum. It really smooths my skin and makes it feel baby soft. So glad I picked this one up!

I received an advanced bottle of this product to try before mass release, in exchange for an honest review. I already own and use the Hyaluronic Sea Serum, but immediately came to love the Dream Night Serum as my number 1 serum choice (and Ive tried a LOT of serums over the years). I began using it on its own, without a layer of moisturizer over it, in order to test the efficacy of the product alone. Even without a moisturizer additive, it softened and moisturized my skin while also keeping it firm. I began to see a reduction in fine lines and an overall change in tone and texture. It smoothed out my skin and gave me a more even-looking complexion. I then paired it with my Collagen Dream Night Cream, and the combination is perfect for year-round nighttime skin care. There was no sensitivity or adjustment period with this bio retinol alternative as with typical retinol or retinoid products, and the serum delivers results quickly. It is rich, smells amazing, and soaks up into your skin, without leaving any oily or sticky residue, just glowing skin. I will absolutely be purchasing a replacement bottle when this one is gone. I now cant imagine my nighttime skin care regimen without it. Lovely product, thank you!
I love Osea serums and this is the perfect addition! I will be adding this one to my nightly routine! Smells amazing!
Feels so great and lightweight on my skin! Perfect addition to my skincare routine to help fight wrinkles and minimize them.

Gifted by Osea.
